description: This file defines the class 'redminerestInterface', which provides an interface for integrating with Redmine as an issue tracker within a larger testing or issue management system, including methods for connecting to Redmine, retrieving issues, creating issues, and adding comments. It relies on an external Redmine PHP API library and manages configuration details, issue attributes, and API communication.

classes.name: redminerestInterface
classes.description: A class that manages interaction with Redmine's REST API for retrieving, creating, and updating issues within an integrated testing or issue management system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration, sets up default statuses, and establishes API connection with Redmine.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes configuration attributes, setting defaults for URLs and attributes, and parses custom attributes from XML.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance for Redmine communication.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of an issue ID (bug ID).

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Redmine by initializing the API client and verifying connectivity.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Redmine is active.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves an issue from Redmine given its ID, returning a structured object with relevant properties.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Fetches the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Fetches the verbose status string of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML-formatted summary string for a specific issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether an issue ID exists in Redmine.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine with provided summary, description, and optional parameters.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note/comment to an existing Redmine issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides an XML template string for configuring the Redmine issue tracker integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issue creation via API is supported, based on configuration.
